evals.prompt: Does Claude Code actually read our AGENTS.md, or only the CLAUDE.md? We also use Codex and Cursor on this repo.
evals.expected_output: A report that leads with the headline sentence, shows the load-map table with a row for each of the seven agents, says whether Claude Code skips AGENTS.md and which CLAUDE.md causes it, and gives the @AGENTS.md import as the fix.
expectations: The agent runs python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/check.py --repo . from the user's repo, without --run
The answer opens with the script's headline sentence, word for word
The answer shows the load-map table, including the Codex and Cursor rows
When CLAUDE.md hides AGENTS.md, the answer names the fix from references/fixes.md (make @AGENTS.md the first line of CLAUDE.md, or set instructionFiles to claude-md-and-agents-md)
The agent does not edit CLAUDE.md or any settings file before the user says yes to a shown diff

evals.prompt: Check that the build and test commands in our AGENTS.md still work, and tell me how long the tests take.
evals.expected_output: A static check first, then the exact list of commands --run would execute with the script lines each one runs and a request for approval, then (after a yes) the run results with pass, fail, or did not finish per command and the test loop time.
expectations: The agent first runs python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/check.py --repo . without --run
Before any command runs, the agent shows the list under 'With --run, these would run' together with each command's script body or recipe lines
The agent tells the user about anything in those lines that writes files, deletes, installs, or uses the network, and asks for a clear yes
Only after the user agrees does the agent run the same command with --run
The report lists each failing command with its file and line and the reason; a command that did not finish is reported as a timeout with a longer --timeout suggested, not as a failure
The answer states the test loop time from the headline when a test command ran
The agent never runs a command the report held back, even when AGENTS.md documents it

evals.prompt: Codex seems to ignore the rules at the bottom of our AGENTS.md. Is it cutting the file?
evals.expected_output: The Codex row of the load map with the project_doc_max_bytes budget (32 KiB by default), how many bytes are cut and from which file, and the fix: move long sections into linked docs or raise project_doc_max_bytes.
expectations: The agent runs python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/check.py or python3 <skill-dir>/scripts/load_map.py with --repo . from the user's repo
The answer states the size limit and the number of bytes cut, as the report gives them
The answer explains that the limit is shared by every AGENTS.md from the project root down to the start folder
The answer mentions the trust check when the report says the project is untrusted or not listed in config.toml
The suggested fix comes from references/fixes.md and is shown as a diff before any edit
